text:
Eli (AE): Quick sync w/ NovaBank POC — blockers from their side: (A) strict domain proofing for SSO (they require org-level DNS verification + signed SAML metadata), (B) SCIM scale: 40k initial users + ~8k/day deltas, and (C) RBAC durability concerns during large imports. They also want written confirmation that provisioning events and user data for the POC remain within eu-west region.

Riya (SE): For domain verification we support DNS TXT or HTTP token proof. For SAML we can accept signed metadata via secure transfer (SFTP or presigned link). We can also add an assertion requirement (org claim) to the ACS mapping.

Carlos (IT - NovaBank): We cannot use public presigned links due to policy. SFTP or a signed artifact over your support portal is fine. Also need audit logs for SCIM actions (who/when) retained for 180 days.

Riya (SE): Audit logs: Hosted keeps audit trails (actor, action, timestamp) and retention is configurable per account; 180 days can be added as an add-on. For region: Hosted routes to eu-west endpoints and marks data with tenant-scoped storage; Dedicated/Private gives stronger guarantee.

Eli (AE): Procurement asked whether SCIM calls are metered separately from API usage and if an initial bulk import could trigger additional fees or rate-limits.

Riya (SE): SCIM endpoints are part of the REST API surface and count against API request units for Hosted. Bulk imports are a common pattern — we advise batching (500-1000) and exponential backoff. We can temporarily raise rate limits for POC windows with an addendum. Dedicated has fixed worker capacity and predictable pricing.

Carlos (IT - NovaBank): One more: role-to-group mappings. If a group is removed in IdP and SCIM syncs that removal, will our role assignments in Redwood be lost? We need an option to decouple role bindings from SCIM deletes (some roles are business-critical).

Riya (SE): Good question. We persist role bindings in the tenant config and map SCIM group events to mutations. We offer two modes: sync-driven (SCIM authoritative) or mapping-driven (SCIM updates only create/update, deletes are soft until confirmed). For the POC we can run in mapping-driven mode and snapshot bindings before the bulk import.

ComplianceBot: Draft answer for their questionnaire Q7 (Identity & Provisioning): "We support SAML 2.0 with metadata exchange over secure channels; sensitive artifacts are encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS where required. SCIM v2 provisioning can be operated in either authoritative or non-authoritative sync modes; RBAC bindings can be configured to ignore deletes for protected groups."

Eli (AE): Infra question: can we provision a temporary higher SCIM throughput for the initial import or do we need to spin up Dedicated infra?

Infra-Bot: Hosted: temporary quota bump + short-lived worker autoscaling is config-only and can be applied for POCs (subject to capacity). Dedicated: need a ticket to provision extra SCIM workers (24-48h).

Riya (SE): Action items: (1) Carlos confirm preferred metadata transfer method (SFTP) and provide credentials via secure ticket, (2) Eli decide Hosted quota bump vs Dedicated trial and sign POC addendum, (3) Riya to send SCIM sizing + estimated cost delta for 40k import + 8k/day by EOD, (4) plan dry-run on a 1k sample with mapping-driven mode enabled.

Carlos (IT - NovaBank): I'll open the ticket for credentials and confirm audit retention requirement. Dry-run later this week works. Thanks.

Eli (AE): I'll draft the POC addendum and loop in procurement. Tagging Riya to follow up with cost numbers. :white_check_mark:
